test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie - chart shows the expenditure of a family on different items and their savings throughout the year 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32319cc0a945b78c2c708e3bbe88a5d79b9181b412da6f46292e4b2d42b456c7.png] 

If the total income of the family was ₹1,00,000, how much money (in ₹) was spent on the education of the children?
solution:
**Given:**

Total income = 1,00,000

**Calculation:**

Expenditure on education of children = 12/100 × 100000 = 12,000.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
